items.label: Border Radius
items.description: Corner roundness for cards and buttons app-wide.

items.label: Background Pattern
items.description: A subtle pattern behind the app background.

items.label: Themed Scrollbars
items.description: Thin scrollbars tinted to match the theme.

items.label: Header Border
items.description: Add a border under the top navigation bar.

items.label: Privacy Style
items.description: How amounts look while privacy mode hides them.

items.label: Modern Titlebar
items.description: Restyles the top bar's buttons with matching icons and status chips.

items.label: Modern Toasts
items.description: Restyles notifications as compact cards with a coloured accent.

items.label: Live sidebar
items.description: ABT's sidebar, with live balances, account groups, search and shortcuts. Off shows Actual's own.
items.writes: Renames an account or runs its bank sync when you do so from the sidebar.

items.label: Live sidebar layout
items.description: Standard sidebar, or an icon bar with a separate accounts panel. Applies when the live sidebar is on.

items.label: Sidebar Density
items.description: Adjust the spacing of accounts, nav links, and search in the live sidebar.

items.label: Sidebar Search Bar
items.description: Quickly filter accounts, categories, and pages.

items.label: Sidebar Shortcuts
items.description: Pin quick links and tools to the sidebar.

items.label: Account Icon Picker
items.description: Set a custom favicon or emoji icon per account.

items.label: Account Group Totals
items.description: Show each account group's combined balance beside its name.

items.label: Color Negative Account Balances
items.description: Highlight negative account balances in red.

items.label: Budget Table Row Height
items.description: Adjust how tall each budget table row is.

items.label: Highlight Hovered Budget Row
items.description: Tint the category row under the cursor, so its numbers are easy to follow across.

items.label: Hide Month Selection On Scroll
items.description: Collapse the month navigation row while scrolling the budget table.

items.label: Budget Page Borders
items.description: Add borders around sections of the budget table.

items.label: Month Header
items.description: Replace the budget page's month strip with a header: a month picker, months-shown control, and Today.

items.label: Month Cards
items.description: Compact month headers when several months are shown; with one, a full-width row of To Budget (or savings, on a tracking budget), spending, targets, and quick budget actions.
items.writes: Applies budget templates or covers overspending when you click those actions.

items.label: Budget Card Styling
items.description: Add a spending flow bar to the current month's budget card.

items.label: Category Progress Indicators
items.description: A progress ring next to each budget balance — hover for spending details.

items.label: Balance Status Pills
items.description: Show balances as pills: overspent, or funded and underfunded for categories with templates.

items.label: Schedule Icon Details
items.description: Line up the schedule icons beside the spent amounts, with a hover card for each schedule.

items.label: Show Daily Available
items.description: Show what an account's balance allows per day for the rest of the month.

items.label: Budget Totals Label Styling
items.description: Mute and uppercase the Budgeted/Spent/Balance labels.

items.label: Category Color Dots
items.description: Show a colored dot for each transaction's category.

items.label: Category Emoji Picker
items.description: Set a custom emoji icon for each category.
items.writes: Adds the emoji you pick to the category's name.

items.label: Quiet Category Icons
items.description: Show the template and notes icons on hover, keeping notes visible where there are some.

items.label: Category Filter
items.description: Filter the budget table to categories that need attention (overspent or short of their target) or are funded.

items.label: Budget Insights
items.description: Month summary, template breakdowns, and priority planning in a side panel.
items.writes: Applies the month's budget templates when you click Apply.

items.label: Next Month Coverage Method
items.description: Choose the target used by Next Month Coverage in Plan → Overview.

items.label: Category Template Insights
items.description: Progress bars showing how funded each category's template is.

items.label: Quiet Funded Bars
items.description: Leave fully funded categories as an empty track, so the ones still needing money stand out.

items.label: Goal Funding
items.description: Click a category's balance to see its goal progress and assign money to an underfunded goal.
items.writes: Budgets the rest of a goal to its category when you click Assign.

items.label: Alternating Transaction Row Colors
items.description: Zebra-stripe the transaction table for easier scanning.

items.label: Color Transactions
items.description: Color negative and positive transactions.

items.label: Dim Reconciled Transactions
items.description: Fade reconciled rows in the transaction table.

items.label: Highlight Uncategorized Transactions
items.description: Flag transactions that are missing a category.

items.label: Quiet New Transactions
items.description: Mark newly imported transactions with an accent bar instead of bold colored text.

items.label: Tag Styling
items.description: Color #tags in notes and transaction fields.

items.label: Resizable Transaction Columns
items.description: Drag column edges to resize the transaction table.

items.label: Modern Account Toolbar
items.description: Restyles the account page's actions, search and icon buttons with matching icons.

items.label: Modern Reconcile
items.description: Reconcile in a side panel: live balances, clear transactions from a list, one-click adjustment and undo.
items.writes: Clears transactions you tick, adds an adjustment if you ask, and locks them when you finish.

items.label: Reconcile Confetti
items.description: Celebrate with a burst of confetti when an account balances and you finish.

items.label: Sync recap
items.description: After a bank sync or import, review what came in and categorize it in the side panel.
items.writes: Sets a transaction's category when you pick one in the recap.

items.label: Transaction Inspector
items.description: Inspect the transaction you select in a side panel: payee history, the rules that mention it, and its schedule.

items.label: Dark Report Cards
items.description: Use a darker background for widget cards on the Reports page.

items.label: Report Card Borders
items.description: Add borders around widget cards on the Reports page.

items.label: Modern Reports Header
items.description: Keep the Reports title and dashboard buttons in view while scrolling, titled as a quiet breadcrumb.

items.label: Spending Calendar
items.description: A calendar view of daily spending, added to the sidebar.

items.label: Income Breakdown widget
items.description: Adds an Income Breakdown chart to the Reports dashboard's Add widget menu.

items.label: Header
items.description: Gives page headers a native look: the page's colour, a hairline, and a plain title.

items.label: Tab bar
items.description: Replaces the slide-up menu with a tab bar, and puts the other pages under More.

items.label: Cards
items.description: Budget groups, account lists and report widgets as rounded cards, or flush sections.

items.label: Accounts
items.description: Lists accounts in your sidebar groups, with their icons and group totals.

items.label: Budget banners
items.description: Restyles the overspent and uncategorized banners as quiet cards with a coloured icon.

items.label: Modals as sheets
items.description: Opens Actual's pop-up windows as sheets from the bottom, closed by swiping down.

items.label: Transaction list
items.description: Restyles account transactions as a native list, with quiet date headings.

items.label: Snackbar toasts
items.description: Shows notifications as compact snackbars above the tab bar, with the action as text.

items.label: Page transitions
items.description: How each page appears as you move between them.
